haiku.problem: The verses never say the LORD speaks the warning in 14:29. The Prep card said "the message," and the question adds an attribution that isn't stated in the lesson's verses.
The verses never say the LORD speaks in 14:29-30. The speaker is only "I" in the text, so naming the LORD adds a fact not stated in the verses.
The verses tell the gate and the city to wail, not the Philistines. The question says the LORD told the Philistines to wail, which misstates the passage.
